name: AECi — Perspective API outage (>50% errors, 15m)
message:
More than 50% of Perspective API toxicity calls failed over 15m (AECI-206 / Phase 5.15). `aeci.perspective.api{outcome:failed}` carries a `reason` (`http_error` / `malformed` / `timeout` / `network`); `aeci.perspective.api.duration_ms` is the paired latency. Perspective scoring is **fail-open** (`lib/perspective.ts`) — an outage does NOT block or auto-reject review submissions; the review still enters the moderation queue with `toxicity_score = null`. So this is NOT user-facing: it means the moderation queue temporarily loses its toxicity triage signal (the worst content no longer floats to the top). First checks: read `service:aeci-api source:perspective` warn logs for the `reason`; confirm `PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY` is set/valid on the Worker (a missing key is a silent no-op and emits NO metric, so it can't trip this); check Google's Perspective status; correlate a `timeout`-dominated spike with the 2s client cap.

Note: deliberately NO notify_no_data — Perspective is called only on review submissions (rare at pre-launch), so zero calls is normal and a no-data alert would be constant noise. Only the failure *ratio* is meaningful. The 50% threshold is launch-tunable.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#perspective-api-outage
